newsitem.title: USA: Evesham, N.J., rejects $27.7 mln bond ballots.
newsitem.headline: Evesham, N.J., rejects $27.7 mln bond ballots.

text.p: Voters in Evesham, N.J., on Tuesday decisively rejected a total of $27.7 million in school bond ballot questions, a board of education official said Wednesday.
The vote was broken into two pieces, and both were rejected.
The first question asked voters to authorize $15.9 million for upgrading equipment and expanding instructional space. It was rejected by a vote of 2,488 to 1,895.
Question two asked for authorization to sell $11.8 million to build additions to several elementary schools. It was rejected 2,537 to 1,758.
The referendum was structured so that if only one issue had been approved, neither would have been acted upon.
